parent: X01 plugin lifecycle; future Web consumer, not current seven-path runtime-management slice
finding: A reviewed read-only removal-reference client now exists, but the current Web PluginManagement has no reference observation surface. Its generic useRead intentionally retains prior data and discards typed error details; directly reusing it across material/cursor identity changes would obscure the new API semantics.
proposedBehavior: Expose a host-owned View task references action for the selected registration and exact material installation operation, through the existing management extension surface. Keep the consumer read-only.
Show active, uncertain and historical classifications with their server reason, task/attempt binding and full inspectable identity. Do not call historical rows live users of the material.
Label coverage registration tool-task bindings and host release unknown. Empty results and historical-only pages never become safe-to-uninstall or physical-removal permission.

Read exactly one page per explicit action, up to 40 rows/64 KiB. Empty pages can have Next. Preserve opaque cursor and server ordering/microsecond timestamps. Independent snapshots do not support total counts or a global all-clear.

Bind reader lifetime/cache to session, registration and installation operation; display response currentRevision/version/store/material identity. Abort on close/change and reject a late old result. Separate current data from retained stale data.

On typed plugin_removal_cursor_changed 409, keep the attempted cursor and current evidence; offer explicit Restart from first page. UNKNOWN read errors are read failures, never a pending write command or permission for retrying a different operation.

Do not deduplicate same physical material across different installation operations by operation id; the response explicitly permits references through other operations. Render text through React and preserve control-character identities as inspectable escaped text.
Keep the existing runtime command controller and original UNKNOWN write key/body independent from these reads. A reference refresh must not issue enable/disable/removal or reset a pending command.
acceptanceCases: One bounded read; empty-with-next explicit continuation; no auto page loop.
Same material with a different installation operation and sub-millisecond ordered references remain visible.
Late response after changing material/session cannot overwrite the new identity.
Cursor 409 requires explicit restart; malformed/aborted response stays unknown, without any write.
Empty/historical pages retain host-release unknown and no physical removal authorization.
390px light/dark, keyboard expansion/paging, reduced motion, long exact identities and escaped text.
integrationBoundary: Client plus required contract must be accepted into the chosen implementation baseline before a new Web slice consumes it. Current Plugin claim seven paths, current browser packet and MSG03 scope are unchanged. Manager should preserve this as explicit pending plan/TODO, then take exact paths through normal ownership before implementation.

cleanCode.applied: Separate read observations from mutation authority; reuse public validated client and host-owned extension seam; avoid a second plugin lifecycle store or a broad useRead rewrite only to support one typed paged reader.
actualFindings: Generic useRead erases typed errors, so the future consumer needs a narrow typed read presentation rather than claiming all failure reasons are equivalent.
Identity changes require scoped state or explicit current/stale presentation; cached old data must not look like the newly selected material.
